L0: Keep the preregistered physical support and depth rules, with their high, low and unknown states. For the binary risk scores 0 or 1 the decision boundary is 0.5. L0 contributes its actual attainable rule point to coverage comparisons.
thresholds: Each listed method gets its own development-only low-risk operating threshold using the study rule. Report the attained coverage. Full tie groups determine the available coverage choices.
system_counts: L, H and U partition E, the reference-and-prediction-valid RGB population. Low-risk coverage is L/V. A pixel with reference-valid and prediction-invalid RGB is reported as invalid output in V outside E.
ranking: The five-method common-score mask is intersected with E for ranking comparisons. Every method also has its own system coverage.
